review_notes.note: PDF uses a dollar symbol; actual supplier product pages establish USD and per-package basis. Keep printed PDF observation distinct from current page prices.
Merged cells are explicitly represented by source HTML rowspan and colspan. Expanded values retain the original cell coordinate and inherited marker.
The two Nominal Current rows occur under different voltage/rating contexts; preserve UL and IEC fields separately and retain the source qualifier depends on AWG.
Keep complete supplier SKUs; shared base product specification columns do not collapse distinct package offerings.
Preserve both published mm and inch texts exactly. Do not recompute or silently correct the printed conversions.

Keep all120 source cells, including dashes, independently. Eleven positive221-series cells recur on both pages; deduplicate only their normalized relationship while retaining both source observations. Six2773-series identifiers are referenced products, without sales rows in this selected source.
Adobe extraction emits an em-dash plus en-dash for207-1372×2773-406. Preserve its original glyphs and do not treat as numeric capacity.
Price basis and physical package quantity require explicit source-backed mapping. Qty is not inventory availability and must never populate stock count.

The current supplier page lists 221-612 and 221-613; both PDF compatibility tables also list 221-615 with capacity 1. Preserve each source observation; absence from a shorter current description does not establish incompatibility.
